def solve(inputs):
    n = inputs['n']
    step = inputs['step']
    remaining_people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    index = 0
    while len(remaining_people) > 1:
        index = (index + step - 1) % len(remaining_people)
        del remaining_people[index]
    return remaining_people[0]
